description:
Company: 
Qualcomm Technologies, Inc. 
 Job Area: 
Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Cellular Technologies Software 
 General Summary: 
 The Wireless R&D group is focused on developing a Test Base Station (TBS) for verification of QCT mobile chipset functionality. We are seeking a software engineer for an exciting opportunity to collaborate in the implementation and verification of complex wireless systems. The successful candidate will be part of a diverse, experienced team developing cutting edge features for 5G and 6G wireless technologies for the 5G/6G TBS product. Sophisticated multi-thread software is written in C++ and implemented as a Linux service. Fast paced development is supported by Continuous Integration processes and systems.
 
 Minimum Qualifications: 
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field. 
 
 
 Responsibilities 
 Own 5G/6G Radio Access Network (RAN) Layer 2 (MAC, RLC, PDCP, SDAP) responsibilities

 Drive 3GPP 5G/6G feature development from specification through commercialization

 Design and develop L2 functionality, including DL and UL channel configuration, data-plane and call flows

 Implement and optimize fixed and dynamic DL and UL channel schedulers, data-plane paths

 Interface with NodeB Layer 3 (RRC) and Layer 1 (PHY) components

 Develop real-time-sensitive, multi-core, and multi-threaded software for the NodeB

 Debug, profile, and optimize software for latency, throughput, and reliability on the target platform

   
 Required Skills 
 2+ years of experience in SW design and development with the C++ programming language, or strong C programming with familiarity in object-oriented concepts

 Experience with the full software development life cycle

 Familiarity with 3GPP 4G/5G specifications. Acumen to read and understand the 3GPP specifications and translate them to requirements

 Familiarity with developing and working in a Linux environment

 Knowledge of multi-core, multi-threaded programming, and associated OS concepts

 Familiarity with industry-standard software development and debugging tools (IDEs, build systems, git, gdb).

 Familiarity with AI based tools/agentic workflows to improve work productivity

 Strong analytical, debugging, and communication skills with the ability to work effectively across cross-functional distributed teams

 Preferred Skills 
 Hands-on experience in designing and developing LTE/5G L2 (MAC, RLC, PDCP, SDAP) or RAN software

 Experience with real-time scheduling, DPDK, or performance tuning on multi-core platforms.

 Familiarity with modern C++ (17/20/23)

 Experience with hands-on Python is a plus

 Pay range and Other Compensation & Benefits : 
$109,400.00 - $164,200.00

 If you would like more information about this role, please contact Qualcomm Careers .
